display.purpose: Screen titles on result screens only. One per screen.

button.purpose: All button labels and tab navigation. Large for tap confidence on a small window.

body.purpose: Message box content and status text. The only prose-length copy in the app.

label.purpose: Field labels above inputs, all-caps, sparse use.

small.purpose: Divider text, countdown, file list. Supporting roles only.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: All hover/active state changes: background color, border color, opacity.

motion.name: urgent-threshold
motion.purpose: Countdown time color shifts to Alarm Red when 5 minutes remain. CSS class toggle only, no animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Upload and Save & Pair. The only Terracotta Signal surface in the UI.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f76f53; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; transition: background 0.12s; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e5614a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Pull and Forget. Near-black, authority without aggression.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #28262f; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; transition: background 0.12s; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #38363f; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Done. Secondary action on result screens. Recedes from the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); color: #1a1914; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.09); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Sync Code Input
components.description: Sync code entry. Acts as a display element at rest; large, centered, uppercase.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; border: 2px solid #9b9781; border-radius: 10px; color: #1a1914; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 16px 13px; width: 100%; outline: none; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 0.12s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1a1914; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9b9781; font-weight: 500; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Message Box — Error
components.description: Blocking error state. Blush background, Alarm Red text. Replaces inline status text.
components.html: Quit Zen completely before pushing.
components.css: .ds-message { border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; width: 100%; } .ds-message-error { background: #fadbd1; color: #b80000; } .ds-message-success { background: #e7f9d9; color: #336d3f; } .ds-message-neutral { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); color: #1a1914; }

components.name: Message Box — Success
components.description: Confirmation state. Sage Wash background, Forest Affirmation text.
components.html: Paired! Automatic sync is active.
components.css: .ds-message { border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; width: 100%; } .ds-message-success { background: #e7f9d9; color: #336d3f; } .ds-message-error { background: #fadbd1; color: #b80000; } .ds-message-neutral { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); color: #1a1914; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: The app's only navigation. Active tab bleeds into canvas by matching its color exactly.
components.css: .ds-app-header { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); height: 76px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 0 32px; } .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-tab { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1914; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; padding: 16px 24px 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; outline: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab-active { background: #f2f0e3; } .ds-tab-inactive:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.09); }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Terracotta-filled when checked. The only other legal use of the primary accent.
components.css: .ds-toggle-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #28262f; cursor: pointer; } .ds-checkbox { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 4px; border: 2px solid #9b9781; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; position: relative; transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s; outline: none; } .ds-checkbox:hover:not(:checked) { border-color: #f76f53; } .ds-checkbox:checked { background: #f76f53 url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 16 16' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cpath d='M3 8.5l3.5 3.5 6.5-7' stroke='white' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' fill='none'/%3E%3C/svg%3E") center / 13px no-repeat; border-color: #f76f53; }

narrative.overview:
ZynC feels like the well-considered card that came folded inside a piece of hardware you actually wanted. The parchment background is not beige and it is not off-white; it is specifically this cream, warm and deliberate, chosen to make the terracotta orange feel like it belongs rather than shouts. Bricolage Grotesque at large weights does the structural work. Nothing decorates that doesn't earn its place in a 420-pixel-wide window.

The system is committed, not restrained. One saturated color, Terracotta Signal, carries 30-40% of interactive surface area. It appears on primary buttons and checked states only; its rarity is the point. The near-black ink handles secondary actions with quiet authority. Everything else is the parchment canvas and its translucent overlays.

This system explicitly rejects: developer tooling aesthetics (terminal dark, dense monospace, purple gradients); generic SaaS palettes (white background, blue primaries, card grids); and overwrought macOS chrome (translucency, vibrancy, excessive system-native metaphors).
keyCharacteristics: One committed accent, used with restraint
Typography at display sizes (24-32px) on a small fixed window
Flat surfaces, no shadows, depth through tonal overlays
Status communicated through colored message boxes, never inline text
Two actions: Upload and Pull. The interface has nothing else to say.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta Signal appears on interactive primary surfaces only: Upload, Save & Pair, Copy, and checked checkbox states. If a fourth use case is proposed, reconsider the design first. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Paired Signal Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors are always used in pairs: blush background with alarm text, sage background with forest text. Applying either alone violates the pairing and produces unacceptable contrast ratios.

rules.name: The Two-Size Rule
rules.body: New screens may only introduce typography at sizes already in use: 32, 24, 14, 12, or 11px. Adding a new size requires removing an existing one. The small fixed window cannot sustain a larger scale.

rules.name: The Weight Signal Rule
rules.body: Bold (700-800) appears exclusively in the countdown timer's time value, to signal urgency by weight before color. It is the only place 700+ weight is used outside hover states.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow for depth or separation. Tonal overlays only. If a component needs to feel elevated above its siblings, reconsider its placement before reaching for shadows.

rules.name: The Tonal Hierarchy
rules.body: Three tones only: Parchment (base), 5% overlay (resting interactive surface), 9% overlay (hover or pressed). A fourth tonal level is a design error.

dos: Do use Terracotta Signal (#f76f53) on primary buttons, Save & Pair, Copy, and checked checkboxes only. Those are the four legal uses.
Do keep the canvas Parchment (#f2f0e3) everywhere. Screens have one background.
Do use message boxes (not inline text) for all status: loading, error, success, instruction.
Do pair semantic colors: Blush Alert + Alarm Red together, Sage Wash + Forest Affirmation together.
Do size button text at 24px. The window is small; tap targets must be confident.
Do let the active tab bleed into the content by matching the canvas color exactly.
Do communicate input focus by shifting the border color to Deep Ink. No glow, no shadow.
donts: Don't use developer tooling aesthetics: terminal dark themes, dense monospace everywhere, purple accents.
Don't use generic SaaS patterns: white background, blue primary buttons, card grids with icon/heading/text.
Don't apply overwrought macOS design: translucency, vibrancy, backdrop-filter.
Don't add shadows. Not for hover states, not for active states, not for z-index depth.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on any element.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasis is weight and size.
Don't introduce a new type size without retiring an existing one.
Don't show Terracotta Signal in a decorative context. It must mean 'do this' every time it appears.
Don't leave a message box visible when there is no message.
